component.name: Home Space
component.summary: Browse, sync and transfer files on your own server

description.p: Home Space is the desktop client for a self-hosted Home Space server. It lets you work with the files on your server as if they were on your computer.

ul.li: Browse, upload, download, move and rename files and folders.
Keep local folders in sync with folders on the server.
Send files and links to your other devices.
Restore deleted files from the recycle bin.
Sign in with a password or through your single sign-on provider.
